metadata.description: Direct-install marketplace for the sprint-ops plugin. A tracker-agnostic Program Lead workflow for any team running sprints.

plugins.name: sprint-ops
plugins.description: Program Lead workflow for any team running sprints. Turns raw inputs (feedback, bug reports, meeting transcripts) into well-formed tickets, preps the sprint for kickoff and poker estimation, runs a mid-sprint progress check, seeds the retrospective, and compiles production release notes. Tracker-agnostic; configurable per user via /setup-sprint.
